title: Raging Bloodgill
summary: A bloodgill call can bring a raging goblin into an ordinary pull.
overview: A bloodgill call can bring a raging goblin into an ordinary pull.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep a spare tank or control available when pushing warriors below sixty percent.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 60% health, a warrior or shaman has a ten-percent chance to summon the raging bloodgill if this event is not already active.
The active-state marker is scoped to the current instance and expires after thirty minutes.
Killing the raging goblin clears the marker and allows another eligible trigger.

notes: Approval E390. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
